prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Baytown, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1016; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my full name on the recording, but you have my claim file, so that should be fine.

Q: Understood. Do you agree this statement is being recorded with your permission?
A: Yes, I agree.

Q: Can you tell me what happened in the collision?
A: I was driving in Baytown, Texas, on a multi-lane road. I was changing lanes to move over for an exit, I checked my mirror and the lane looked clear. A vehicle in the lane I was entering was in my blind spot and it sideswiped the passenger side of my car.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you moved over?
A: No, I didn't see it. I glanced at the mirror and didn't turn my head to check the blind spot. I should have.

Q: What was the speed of your vehicle at the time?
A: I'd estimate around the posted limit, maybe a little under. Traffic was moving steadily.

Q: Were you injured?
A: Yes. My right shoulder hit the door frame and the seatbelt pulled hard. The shoulder is still sore and I've had trouble lifting my arm above my head.

Q: Did you seek medical attention?
A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic the same day and then I've been seeing my family doctor for follow-up. I'm starting physical therapy next week.

Q: Is there anything you would like to add?
A: Only that I'm sorry the other driver's car was damaged too. I'm willing to cooperate fully with your investigation.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
